recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. Further work is only warranted if a work group wants a separate cleanup of archived examples or generic workflow pattern wording outside this Pharmacy issue.
issue_request: FHIR-25929 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that all Pharmacy resource choices made up of CodeableConcept plus Reference be changed to CodeableReference across Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationKnowledge, MedicationPrescription/MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement.
initial_application: The February 2020 Pharmacy commits 8c940464 and 1dcdc4c applied the main R5 migration and current medication StructureDefinitions now use CodeableReference for the relevant elements with no remaining CodeableConcept+Reference mixed choice. The original application missed active hyphenated example resources that still used medicationReference and several current-source comments/list descriptions that still named reasonCode, reasonReference, or reasonForUseReference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement as active resources and records MedicationPrescription as having become MedicationRequest. MedicationKnowledge source already has CodeableReference at its relevant elements and was later removed from the active fhir.ini resource list. Direct Zulip/Confluence searches found no FHIR-25929-specific conflict; a later minutes page cites the Pharmacy R5 CodeableReference medication update as background for a separate Immunization discussion.
reconciliation: Changed MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, and MedicationRequest example XML from medicationReference to medication CodeableReference/reference form. Updated MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement comments, MedicationRequest example list/header descriptions, and resource-side mapping-exception text to use reason, reason.reference, or coded reason instead of removed choice element names. Left Archive examples and mapping/pattern reasonCode values untouched because they are not current resource element declarations.
source_changes: source/medicationadministration/medicationadministration-example.xml: converted medicationReference to medication.reference CodeableReference XML.
source/medicationdispense/medicationdispense-example.xml: converted medicationReference to medication.reference CodeableReference XML.
source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-example.xml: converted medicationReference to medication.reference CodeableReference XML.
source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml: updated statusReason/reason comments from reasonCode/reasonReference to reason/reason.reference.
source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: updated the reason comment from reasonForUseReference to reason.reference.

source/medicationrequest/list-MedicationRequest-examples.xml and source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-examples-header.xml: changed user-facing example descriptions from reasonCode/reasonReference to coded reason/reason reference wording.

source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-request-mapping-exceptions.xml and source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: updated resource-side exception text to current reason/reason.reference wording.
